name: Yaneura no Lagoon
source:
The story of protagonist Kuugo, who lives a secret life in the outskirts of a village with the lion he has adopted and protects.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/dlaf/=/link/work/aid/vndb/id/RJ153061.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述主角空吾与自己收养并保护的狮子，一同在村庄郊外过着隐秘的生活。

[来自 [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/dlaf/=/link/work/aid/vndb/id/RJ153061.html]DLsite English[/url]]
